title: Isolate susi-gmcp binary unit tests from host SUSI_HOME and workspace
goal: Isolate handle_tool_accepts_tool_alias_and_preserves_request_id and handle_tool_rejects_missing_tool_name_with_error_status in crates/susi-gmcp/src/main.rs with EnvGuard::isolated(), ENV_LOCK, and tempdir workspaces so running susi-gmcp binary tests never synthesizes unregistered_tool_xyz.rs into host ~/.susi/reflexes.
